paragraphs: R' Perata bar R' Elazar ben Perata, grandson of R' Perata the Great. Tannaim in the time of R' Hanina ben Teradyon; this R' Perata was in Rabbi's time. Gittin 33b: he spoke to Rabbi, and Rabbi acted according to his words. Ketubbot 100a; Tosafot write: ‘Perata, son of R' Elazar ben Perata’ means he was a grandson of R' Perata the Great: Perata, R' Elazar's father, was this man's grandfather. End quotation. See above, R' Elazar ben Perata. R' Elazar, his son, was an amora. R' Shimon was his brother.
